## Purpose and implementation

Describe the concrete change and link the roadmap milestone or issue.

## Validation

List commands, results, and CI links. Distinguish checks run from checks planned.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe behavior changes, reference evidence, and relevant documentation updates.

## Risks and follow-up

Record unresolved questions, limits, and the next independently reviewable step.

## Checklist

- [ ] Focused branch targeting `master`; no unrelated changes
- [ ] Relevant tests and required CI pass
- [ ] README, architecture, roadmap, and compatibility notes updated as applicable
- [ ] Licensing and attribution preserved; no proprietary assets or secrets
- [ ] Owner approval required before merging
